concept: CloudWatch agent: EC2 memory and disk metrics
tests: Knowing that memory and disk are in-guest metrics not visible to the hypervisor.
expected: Install and configure the CloudWatch agent to publish memory and disk as custom metrics. Triggers: "memory utilization", "disk space", "in CloudWatch".
why_not: Detailed monitoring only changes frequency (5 → 1 min) and adds no memory/disk; CloudTrail is API calls; Config is configuration state.
